task.title: Expose a solution-map constructor for the constraint solver's result path
task.description: The solve paths in `crates/reify-constraints/src/solver.rs` need a single named entry point for turning a set of auto-parameter specifications plus their computed f64 solution values into the `HashMap<ValueCellId, Value>` the solution record carries. Provide `create_solution_map(specifications: &[AutoParam], solution_values: &[f64]) -> HashMap<ValueCellId, Value>` alongside the other solver helpers: each pair becomes a `(spec.id, Value::Scalar { si_value, dimension })` entry whose dimension comes from `dimension_of(&spec.param_type)`, matching the `(ValueCellId, Value::Scalar)` shape the solver already hands back to its callers. The two slices are always produced together, so the helper should assert they are the same length and fail loudly at the construction site rather than pairing them short. Document the entry point so the early-exit, fallback and solution-construction paths can all route through it.
